subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after-compaction hooks expose only the new current-session `resetSession(reason?)` contract, or also preserve an explicit-key signature from the closed unmerged reset API proposal and deployed external plugin forks?
rationale: This creates a public plugin API and compatibility obligation; repository policy does not treat a closed unmerged proposal or external fork usage as a shipped contract, but maintainers may intentionally sponsor a migration bridge.

options.title: Ship reason-only API
options.body: Expose only `resetSession(reason?)`, remove the explicit-key overload, and require external plugins to adopt the current-session contract.

options.title: Sponsor explicit-key compatibility
options.body: Keep an explicit-key overload with an unambiguous required/defaulted reason, focused compatibility tests, documentation, and a named removal or support policy.

options.title: Pause the API addition
options.body: Keep reset policy internal until the plugin contract, lifecycle proof, and ownership boundary are agreed separately.

recommendation.title: Ship reason-only API
recommendation.body: Expose only `resetSession(reason?)`, remove the explicit-key overload, and require external plugins to adopt the current-session contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-reset and architecture history makes this the strongest available owner for the public plugin contract decision.
